citation: Retrospective study, Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Zhengzhou University: mNGS for diagnosis of CNS infections after alternative donor allogeneic HSCT, 2021 (Frontiers-type article)
study_design: Retrospective cohort (diagnostic feasibility/sensitivity analysis of mNGS in CNS symptoms after AD-HSCT)

population.population_description: 20 patients with CNS symptoms after AD-HSCT; 15 diagnosed with CNS infections (4 single, 11 mixed), 5 with noninfectious causes (PRES n=3, TA-TMA n=1, hypertensive transient seizure n=1)

index_test.platform_or_panel: mNGS on BGISEQ-200 platform (50 bp single-end), DNA library; Kraken2 bioinformatics with in-house microbial database and threshold criteria (SSRN/RPM)
index_test.dna_and_or_rna: DNA only (DNA extraction with Humoral microbial DNA Kit; no RNA library described)

reference_standard: Clinical diagnosis combining routine CSF testing, biochemistry, G/GM experiments, ink and acid-fast staining, bacterial culture, qPCR (CMV, EBV, BKPyV, HHV), neuroimaging (MRI/CT), and treatment response; negative patients attributed to PRES/TA-TMA/seizure

diagnostic_yield.basis: 21/29 tests positive; 15/20 patients diagnosed with CNS infections by mNGS-guided clinical diagnosis (5 fungal, 6 bacterial, 13 viral cases)

additional_yield_vs_conventional: Thirteen patients tested positive for virus while the qPCR detection method of 6 identical specimens were below the minimum detection limit (<1×10^3 U/ml)
therapy_change: Treatment administered based on pathogen test results per AGIHO/DGHO guidelines; neurological symptoms improved in 10 of 20 patients after treatment
mortality_or_outcomes: Twelve patients died (10 mainly of nervous system infection); median survival time of 15 patients with CNS infections 30 (7–152) days; survival 26.7% (4/15) with CNS infection vs 80% (4/5) without

quality_flags.overlap_risk: reference standard heavily incorporates mNGS results (negative patients classified as PRES/TA-TMA/seizure); all 15 mNGS-positive patients counted as infections — circularity prevents 2x2 construction

quadas2_notes: Retrospective, single centre, n=20. No independent 2x2 vs final diagnosis reported; final infection classification is co-defined by mNGS positivity, so diagnostic accuracy cannot be estimated. Yield data usable. Adult and paediatric (median age 12).

evidence_quotes.quote: We retrospectively analyzed the data of 20 patients with CNS symptoms who received AD-HSCT at the Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Zhengzhou University between February 2019 and December 2020.
A total of 29 tests were performed with 21 of them being positive.

Of the five negative patients, three were diagnosed with a posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome, one as having transplantation-associated thrombotic microangiopathy, and one with transient seizure caused by hypertension. Fifteen patients tested positive, of which four had single infections and eleven had mixed infections.
Five cases of fungal infections, six cases of bacterial infections, and 13 cases of viral infections were detected.
Thirteen patients tested positive for virus while the qPCR detection method of 6 identical specimens were below the minimum detection limit(<1×10 3  U/ml).
According to the protocol of the BGISEQ-200 sequencing platform, the DNA library was constructed through DNA fragmentation, end-repair, adapter-ligation, and PCR amplification.
Twelve patients died, and the main cause of death was a nervous system infection in 10 patients, and severe pneumonia and organ failure in two patients. Eight patients survived.
The survival rate of patients without CNS infection was 80% (4/5), and the survival rate of patients with CNS infection was only 26.7% (4/15).

exclusion_reason: No 2x2 vs independent reference standard; reference classification incorporates mNGS results (circularity). n=20 patients, retrospective, yield-only data usable.
